summary: Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) 9 and RHEL 10 images for GitHub-hosted larger runners are now generally available. Originally introduced in public preview in June 2026 in partnership with Red Hat, these images are now fully supported for production workflows in GitHub Actions.
takeaways: Originally introduced in public preview in June 2026 in partnership with Red Hat, these images are now fully supported for production workflows in GitHub Actions.
You can use RHEL images to run your workflows on the same operating system you deploy to, or as the foundation for custom images that include your required tools, dependencies, and configurations.
Your existing runners and workflows will continue to work as-is.
